sources.summary: Promotion: Swiss bathroom specialist Laufen presented two installations during this year's Milan design week, which showcased its latest material innovation and a refreshed brand image. Both Experience Tomorrow installations, at Fuorisalone and in Laufen's Milan showroom, offered an immersive journey through the brand's latest innovations. On show were Laufen's material developments such as Vitreon steel, The post Laufen spotlights reinvented identity in Experience Tomorrow installations appeared first on Dezeen .
